name: Question 13
problem:
Given the recurrence relation

$$
{a}_{n+1}=7{a}_{n}-6{a}_{n-1},\,{a}_{1}=5,\,{a}_{2}=35,\,n\in N,\,n\ge 2
$$

use strong induction to prove the following statement:

$$
{a}_{n}={6}^{n}-1,\,∀n\in N
$$

**Base Cases**: We first prove that our statement is true for the base cases $n=$ {{field-1}}.

For $n=1,$ for the left-hand side, we have

$$
{a}_{1}={{field-2}}
$$

and for the right-hand side, we have

$$
{{field-3}}={{field-4}}.
$$

For $n=2,$ for the left-hand side, we have

$$
{a}_{2}={{field-5}}
$$

and for the right-hand side, we have

$$
{{field-6}}={{field-7}}.
$$
